# Legacy research regression fixture

`research_v1` is a two-record subset derived from the preserved genuine v0.4
OpenFootball CC0 package `5f99ba32f796fb23`. It keeps one observed and one unknown
Colombia record's original v1 fields, IDs, event hashes and collection clock.
The subset's coverage summaries, changed-row poll count, Gold tables and manifest
are recomputed for two records. It is a test fixture, not a fresh acquisition.

The subset dataset is `f07a33073ce37319`; exact bytes are protected by Git
attributes. Attribution and source URLs remain inside each record. The data
retains [CC0-1.0](https://github.com/openfootball/football.json/blob/master/LICENSE.md).
